title: Red Hat Security Advisory: oci-seccomp-bpf-hook security update
description: Red Hat issued a security advisory for the oci-seccomp-bpf-hook package addressing two denial of service vulnerabilities in Go libraries used by the package. The vulnerabilities include unencrypted HTTP/2 connections susceptible to denial of service (CVE-2026-56853) and a memory limit bypass in multipart form parsing also leading to denial of service (CVE-2026-94440). The update is rated as Important and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. A security update is available to remediate these issues.
